# webview-tuner

> One-file, zero-dependency overlay for pixel-tuning pages inside
> uninspectable webviews (wallet in-app browsers, TWAs). The user nudges
> elements on the real device and copies a text report; an AI coding agent
> turns the report into a source-level CSS fix.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4oko4ow/webview-tuner/main/SKILL.md): complete agent instructions - how to wire the script into a project, what to tell the user, the report format line by line, and the rules for turning reported pixel offsets into proper CSS (fix formulas, not constants)
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4oko4ow/webview-tuner/main/README.md): human-facing overview and per-agent install guides
- [webview-tuner.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4oko4ow/webview-tuner/main/webview-tuner.js): the script itself - dormant unless the URL contains ?wvtune=1

## Install (for agents)

Copy webview-tuner.js into the project's static assets, load it on the pages
being debugged, keep SKILL.md available as your instruction source for
interpreting reports.
